title: kk7.2: landing page HTML const + GET / handler stub
description:
What: Create crates/mail/src/landing.rs with a const LANDING_PAGE_HTML string and a minimal axum handler returning it.

Algorithm:
1. Create crates/mail/src/landing.rs with:
   pub const HTML: &str = r#"<!DOCTYPE html>..."#;
   The HTML should include:
   - Title: 'usenet-ipfs JMAP mail server'
   - A brief description: 'This is a JMAP mail server. Connect with any RFC 8620 client.'
   - autodiscovery note: /.well-known/jmap for client configuration
   - Links to Lollipop (https://github.com/jmaprs/lollipop) and Cypht as recommended clients
   - A note about the base_url requirement: 'Operators must set [listen] base_url to the externally-reachable server URL'
   The HTML must be self-contained (no external CSS/JS), valid HTML5, <2KB.
2. Add handler: pub async fn landing_page() -> impl axum::response::IntoResponse
   Returns (StatusCode::OK, [(CONTENT_TYPE, "text/html; charset=utf-8")], HTML)
3. Add 'pub mod landing;' to lib.rs (if not already present) or add to server.rs directly.

Defensive programming:
- No dynamic content in the HTML (entirely static, no state access needed)
- Content-Type must be text/html; charset=utf-8
- No external resource fetches from the HTML

Tests: unit test that landing_page() returns 200 and Content-Type: text/html.
Acceptance: cargo check passes; handler returns HTML with correct content-type.
